text: Malot Temple Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Malot Temple Type: Monument - Temple Province: Punjab District: Jhelum Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 7th - early 11th Century CE Description: The temple is built in four squares in Kashmir style with a recessed bay in each face and flanked by flouted columns capped by a trefoil arch. The roof which had fallen years ago, was in all probability, built of stone in pyramidal shape and comprised of two or more stages. It was the product of the period of king Lalita Ditya of Kashmir, who ruled over north Punjab including salt range.
